Market today: Inflation jitters are back, with the Fed signaling more hikes. This is the real driver for your tech/chip names, which are already under pressure.

Your holdings: SMH (-24%), SMCI (-36.67%), SOXL (-75.06%), and MU (-59.4%) are all marked SELL and are deep in the red. Given your margin concentration, these drawdowns are amplified and need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep an eye on Nvidia (NVDA) news, especially ahead of earnings, as it often sets the tone for the chip sector.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your deeply underwater leveraged positions and the broader tech sentiment driven by inflation fears.
plays: Trim SMH: Consider reducing exposure given the SELL status and significant loss.
Trim SMCI: Evaluate cutting losses further due to the SELL status and deep drawdown.
Trim SOXL: Assess reducing this highly leveraged, deeply negative position.
